name: godotengine/godot
description: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine with a complete editor and MIT license. It supports export to desktop, mobile, and web platforms with GDScript, C#, and C++ bindings.
score_rationale: The most popular open-source 3D game engine in the world with 108k stars, MIT license, complete editor, and massive active community.
summary: World's most popular open-source 3D/2D engine with complete editor
